name: AI-Assisted Digital Forensics and Incident Investigation
description: Apply AI to digital forensics and incident investigation while keeping forensic discipline: evidence acquisition and chain of custody, AI-assisted triage of endpoints with Velociraptor, super-timelines with Plaso and Timesketch, LLM-assisted log, memory and malware analysis, and defensible reporting that documents every AI-assisted step.
fieldOfStudy: Security by AI: AI for Cyber Defense

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: AI-Assisted Digital Forensics and Incident Investigation

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 17 lessons in 6 modules; and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 45 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
